definition: A fortunate discovery made by accident.

definition: Lasting for only a short time.

definition: The earthy smell after rain falls on dry ground.

definition: Sweet and smooth to hear.

definition: Too great or intense to be described in words.

definition: Present or found everywhere.

definition: A strong desire to travel and explore.

definition: Denoting a peaceful, happy period in the past.

definition: Extremely delicate and light, as if not of this world.

definition: Giving off light; radiant.
